primary_population: contract-permitted frozen test tasks within each world
primary_comparator_rule: highest equal-weight mean eligible_f1 on validation worlds among released non-LGR retrieval baselines

uncertainty.pairing: method scores remain paired within each resampled world

exclusion_rule: No generated world is excluded after execution; failures are retained and reported.
notes: World count is an engineering budget, not a power guarantee.
All worlds share the generator family and therefore do not represent independent organizations.
The comparator is selected using validation worlds before test-world summary computation.
